name: illogical-editor
description: Your editor in the illogical swarm: who's in which file, follow its cursor from a phone, debugger stops and Claude Code's diffs on the rail. And illogical's colours.

illogical.block.description: The editor block this window is (illogical sets it in the block's workspace).
